method: Two independent transcriptions from the page images (transcribers A and B: Claude Sonnet 5.5 subagents under one written brief, without the OCR, each other or outside knowledge; pages 269 and 369 of A were the primary's worked examples). Compared entry by entry; each disagreement and each uncertain spot settled by the primary against the full-resolution scan; printed components checked against printed totals.

audit.method: After reconciliation the primary checked every entry on a seeded random sample of pages against the page images: the header (year, date, type words, place, category), the location, the sentence or table naming winner and loser, and the strength and loss statements. It is a check of the transcription against the images by a reader who had already seen the frame listings, not a blind third transcription.

audit.note: No discrepancy in 42 entries gives a one-sided 95% upper bound of 6.9% on the per-entry rate of frame-field errors left after reconciliation.
